import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Cell {
        int r, c, dis;
        Cell(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dRow = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dCol = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    
    static Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] line = new char[15];
    
    static int vertexCount = 0, source = 0, sink = 0, m, limit;
    static int totalPath = 0;
    static int[] height = new int[202];
    static int[] gap = new int[203];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[202][202];
    static int[][] currentFlow = new int[202][202];
    static int[] pathStack = new int[202];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] originalMap = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean pathExists = false;
    
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];

    static void dfsPush(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == sink) {
            height[0] = bottleneck;
            pathExists = true;
            return;
        }
        int minLevel = sink + 2;
        for (int v = 0; v <= sink + 1; ++v) {
            if (currentFlow[u][v] < capacity[u][v]) {
                minLevel = Math.min(minLevel, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    pathStack[++totalPath] = v;
                    dfsPush(v, Math.min(bottleneck, capacity[u][v] - currentFlow[u][v]));
                    if (!visited[0][0] || pathExists) return;
                    pathStack[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (currentFlow[v][u] > 0) {
                minLevel = Math.min(minLevel, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    pathStack[++totalPath] = -v;
                    dfsPush(v, Math.min(bottleneck, currentFlow[v][u]));
                    if (!visited[0][0] || pathExists) return;
                    pathStack[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (minLevel + 1 != height[u]) {
            --gap[height[u]];
            if (gap[height[u]] == 0) visited[0][0] = false;
            height[u] = minLevel + 1;
            ++gap[height[u]];
        }
    }

    static boolean findAugmentingPath() {
        pathExists = false;
        height[0] = sink;
        totalPath = 0;
        pathStack[0] = 0;
        dfsPush(0, sink);
        return pathExists;
    }

    static void updateFlow() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalPath; ++i) {
            if (pathStack[i] > 0) {
                currentFlow[Math.abs(pathStack[i - 1])][pathStack[i]] += height[0];
            } else {
                currentFlow[-pathStack[i]][Math.abs(pathStack[i - 1])] -= height[0];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        limit = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                line[j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (line[j] == 'Z') {
                    Cell start = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(start);
                } else if (line[j] != 'Y') {
                    visited[i][j] = true;
                    originalMap[i][j] = true;
                    dist[i][j] = limit;
                    int val = line[j] - '0';
                    if (val > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++vertexCount;
                        capacity[0][vertexCount] = val;
                        sink += val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.arraycopy(visited, 0, originalMap, 0, visited.length);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                line[j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (line[j] == 'Z' || line[j] == 'Y') continue;
                int val = line[j] - '0';
                if (val > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++vertexCount;
                    capacity[vertexCount][m * m + 1] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (vertexCount != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int idx = b[i][j];
                        capacity[idx][vertexCount + 1] = capacity[idx][m * m + 1];
                        capacity[idx][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
            dist[r][c] = cur.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dRow[k];
                int nc = c + dCol[k];
                if (nr >= 1 && nr <= m && nc >= 1 && nc <= m && visited[nr][nc]) {
                    Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                    q.add(next);
                    visited[nr][nc] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                System.arraycopy(originalMap, 0, visited, 0, visited.length);
                visited[i][j] = false;
                Cell start = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                q.add(start);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    Cell cur = q.poll();
                    int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
                    if (b[r][c] > 0 && cur.dis <= dist[r][c]) {
                        capacity[a[i][j]][b[r][c]] = sink;
                    }
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > limit || cur.dis >= dist[r][c]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dRow[k];
                        int nc = c + dCol[k];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nr <= m && nc >= 1 && nc <= m && visited[nr][nc]) {
                            Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                            q.add(next);
                            visited[nr][nc] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        gap[0] = vertexCount + 2;
        visited[0][0] = true;
        while (visited[0][0] && height[0] <= vertexCount + 2) {
            while (findAugmentingPath()) {
                updateFlow();
            }
        }
        
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= vertexCount; ++i) {
            result += currentFlow[i][vertexCount + 1];
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
